def transform(grid):
    # Swap the sparse 5 markers to the background color; clear the background.
    background = Counter(cell for row in grid for cell in row if cell != 5).most_common(1)[0][0]
    return [[background if cell == 5 else 0 for cell in row] for row in grid]
